pythonEnvironment.note: The known fixed-local environment is recorded as an expected environment only. E-019 must verify it again before generating its own execution lock. Do not reuse an E-011, E-017, or E-018 lock.

infrastructureValidation.note: This is non-formal infrastructure validation only. E-019 formal seeds were not used and no formal scientific result was generated.

formalAuthorization.instruction: E-019のformal実行開始を承認します。
formalAuthorization.scope: Authorize E-019 fixed-local formal execution only after a new E-019-specific execution lock is generated and validated. This does not authorize GitHub Actions formal generation and does not reuse any prior experiment lock.

allowedBeforeFormalAuthorization: runtime benchmarking that does not use the E-019 formal seed block
prohibitedBeforeFormalAuthorization: generation of any E-019 formal corpus game
use of E-019 formal seeds for outcome inspection
generation of an E-019 formal execution lock authorizing data generation
relaxation of preregistered sample sizes or decision rules
activationRule: formalExecutionAllowed may be true only after a separate explicit user instruction specific to E-019, after preregistration and infrastructure validation are complete. Prior experiment approvals do not carry over.
formalLockRule: After E-019-specific approval, create a new fixed-local execution lock that records the then-current source commit, preregistration SHA-256, execution-policy SHA-256, runtime, hardware, repository state, and fixed corpus conditions. No prior lock may be reused.
changePolicy: Changing runtime requirements, repository path, approval semantics, corpus sizes, seed ranges, strata, search-profile conditions, primary endpoint, McNemar rule, IUT global rule, Holm standalone inference, or output contract requires a new policy/preregistration version as applicable. Infrastructure-only implementation changes are allowed before formal lock but must be frozen into the E-019 source commit before formal authorization is executed.
